name: tylerschloesser
description: Tyler Schloesser's Claude Code plugins: cdk-core, for personal sites with per-PR CloudFront previews and Google auth on AWS, and epochs, for running a long project as one epoch per session against a plan file.

plugins.name: cdk-core
plugins.description: Drive per-PR CloudFront preview environments, Cognito machine auth, and the four-stack CDK layout that @tylerschloesser/cdk-core builds.

plugins.name: epochs
plugins.description: Run a long project as one epoch per session against a plan file, with a handoff that corrects the plan in place.
